g.text: Budget agent: evidence, decisions, and approval
sync FIRST, then load_state and measure pace
forecast_cash: checking range, bill dip and surplus
up to five advice entries from this
budget month and the preceding three.
Invalid action after one schema retry, or known
Adjustment without recurring cause, or on
Unknown exceptions can fail the run.
decide_signals: one call per signal, cap 3
Output boundary: save alerts and advice
Skip valid no_op; retain outcomes as memory
Human accepts or dismisses each proposal
Wait again until all proposals decided
decide_signals and log_advice if no overspend
Recurring signals: new subscription, price increase, income change.
Keyed recurring replay guard; low-balance repeat policy.
Forecast errors do not stop overspend checks.
Clear signal and prompt facts before approval; save on exit.
Filter every checkpoint write, including failures.
